goal: Eine klar definierte browserlokale Desktop-Vorschau ergänzen. Die Vorschau erhält einen festen 1152-Pixel-Viewport innerhalb eines horizontal scrollbaren Rahmens; Tablet- und schmale Vorschau bleiben getrennte spätere Slices.

guide_delta.summary: Die Vorschau rendert in einem festen Desktop-Viewport mit 1152 px Breite. Ist das Bedienpanel schmaler, bleibt die Desktop-Geometrie erhalten und wird horizontal gescrollt statt responsiv zusammengepresst.

direct_dependencies: I136-I137 semantic/collapsible preview sections are confirmed
I129 persistence boundary remains plan-only and closed
tests_required: run existing test_browser_shell.py as narrow browser-shell regression
desktop preview has a fixed 1152-pixel semantic viewport contract
outer preview shell permits horizontal scrolling when host panel is narrower
desktop mode is explicitly labelled and described
no tablet or narrow mode introduced
tests_explicitly_not_run: database/repository tests because no persistence path changes
Control Plane tests because governance is unchanged
full product suite because the change is browser-local and targeted
new Chromium screenshot evidence because this iteration establishes the desktop viewport contract only
risks: desktop preview must not silently collapse to the narrow host panel width
horizontal scrolling must be confined to the preview shell
future tablet/narrow modes must remain separate contracts
preview mode must not leak into persistence
non_changes: no JSON schema or SQLite changes
no HTTP write route or browser storage
expected_side_effects: desktop geometry remains stable inside the preview panel
the user can inspect the wide preview by horizontal scrolling
the active preview contract is visibly labelled Desktop 1152 px
